description:
The mapping from a blind view's neutral labels (`P1`, `P2`, ...) to the true
directory labels, per image set (every set shuffles its own panes). Never
embedded in the page.

dirs.description: Absolute path of each directory, in `labels` order.

seed.description: The page's random token (`ViewModel::seed`); must match the decisions file.

sets.description:
Per image set, the true label of each pane as displayed: entry `n - 1`
is the label behind the set's neutral label `P<n>`.

shuffle_seed.description: The seed the panes were shuffled with (`--seed` reproduces the view).

title: BlindKey
